test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the profit if a shopkeeper sells the item for Rs. 4673 whose cost price was Rs. 3456.
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the items = Rs. 4673

The cost price of the items = Rs. 3456

**Formula used:**

P = SP - CP Where, P = Profit, SP = Selling price, and CP = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the profit of the items be X.

⇒ X = 4673 - 3456 = 1217

**∴ The required result will be Rs. 1217.**
